## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it address?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why you ruled them out.

## Architecture Check

Does this feature comply with BridgeCam's core principles? (check all that apply)

- [ ] Zero video data on the signaling server
- [ ] No user accounts or stored personal data
- [ ] Works without internet (LAN-only path)
- [ ] No heavy new dependencies (or justified if there are)
- [ ] Privacy-preserving by default

## Additional Context

Any mockups, examples from other apps, or relevant links.
